import RNA, random, time
target='.....((((.(...(.((((.(.((((.((.((((.((.(((....))).).)))))).).))))....).)))).)...).))))....................'
n=len(target)
stack=[]; pairs={}
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(': stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop(); pairs[i]=j; pairs[j]=i
paired_idx=[i for i in pairs]
unpaired=[i for i in range(n) if i not in pairs]
def score(seq):
    s,_=RNA.fold(seq)
    if s==target: return 0
    return RNA.bp_distance(s,target)

# best so far

best=list(base); bs=score(''.join(best))

random.seed(999)

for restart in range(5):
    # randomize unpaired, GC-pair paired
    c=list('A'*n)
    for i in range(n):
        if i in pairs:
            j=pairs[i]
            if i<j:
                a,b=random.choice([('G','C'),('C','G')])
                c[i]=a; c[j]=b
        else:
            c[i]=random.choice('ACGU')
    cb=list(c); cs=score(''.join(cb))
    for it in range(15000):
        cand=list(cb)
        r=random.random()
        if r<0.65 and paired_idx:
            i=random.choice(paired_idx); j=pairs[i]
            a,b=random.choice([('G','C'),('C','G'),('A','U'),('U','A'),('G','U'),('U','G')])
            cand[i]=a; cand[j]=b
        else:
            i=random.choice(unpaired); cand[i]=random.choice('ACGU')
        ns=score(''.join(cand))
        if ns<=cs and (ns<cs or random.random()<0.1):
            cb=cand; cs=ns
        if cs==0: break
        if time.time()-t0>105: break
    if cs<bs:
        best=cb; bs=cs
    if bs==0:
        print("SOLVED restart",restart,flush=True); break
    print("restart",restart,"score",cs,flush=True)
    if time.time()-t0>105: break
print("FINAL",bs,flush=True)
print(''.join(best),flush=True)
print(RNA.fold(''.join(best))[0],flush=True)

import RNA, random, time
# subtarget = structured region positions 5..85 inclusive
target='.....((((.(...(.((((.(.((((.((.((((.((.(((....))).).)))))).).))))....).)))).)...).))))....................'
sub_target=target[5:86]
print("sublen",len(sub_target))
n=len(sub_target)
stack=[]; pairs={}
for i,c in enumerate(sub_target):
    if c=='(': stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop(); pairs[i]=j; pairs[j]=i
paired_idx=[i for i in pairs]
unpaired=[i for i in range(n) if i not in pairs]
def score(seq):
    s,_=RNA.fold(seq)
    if s==sub_target: return 0
    return RNA.bp_distance(s,sub_target)

best=None; bs=999
random.seed(7)
t0=time.time()
for restart in range(200):
    c=list('A'*n)
    for i in range(n):
        if i in pairs:
            j=pairs[i]
            if i<j:
                a,b=random.choice([('G','C'),('C','G'),('A','U'),('U','A')])
                c[i]=a; c[j]=b
        else:
            c[i]=random.choice('ACGU')
    cb=list(c); cs=score(''.join(cb))
    for it in range(4000):
        cand=list(cb)
        r=random.random()
        if r<0.7 and paired_idx:
            i=random.choice(paired_idx); j=pairs[i]
            a,b=random.choice([('G','C'),('C','G'),('A','U'),('U','A'),('G','U'),('U','G')])
            cand[i]=a; cand[j]=b
        else:
            i=random.choice(unpaired); cand[i]=random.choice('ACGU')
        ns=score(''.join(cand))
        if ns<=cs and (ns<cs or random.random()<0.08):
            cb=cand; cs=ns
        if cs==0: break
    if cs<bs:
        best=cb; bs=cs
    if bs==0:
        print("SOLVED restart",restart,flush=True); break
    if time.time()-t0>100: break
print("best",bs,flush=True)
seq=''.join(best)
print(seq,flush=True)
print(RNA.fold(seq)[0],flush=True)
print(RNA.fold(seq)[0]==sub_target,flush=True)
# save for next step
with open('/tmp/sub_sol.txt','w') as f:
    f.write(seq)
